title: Finished gate checks of a session are reported as running across a Central restart
outcome: After a host restart, a gate or test run that had already ended is reported with its recorded terminal result, never as running. Nothing invites or starts a duplicate run of finished work.
acceptance: The code path that reported Opus2's (session-8111) old gate checks as running during the 2026-11-03 06:08Z restart is identified, with the affected run ids and their recorded terminal results.
Whether anything automatically re-runs, re-registers or re-requests verification for such runs is established. Any such path is fixed so that a finished run is never repeated.
A regression test restarts the host over a store holding a finished run and asserts that it is reported terminal with its original result.
